realLifeExampleSummary: Kopfhörer wirken bei 129 Euro günstiger, nachdem zuvor 199 Euro als erster Preis gesehen wurde.
coverVisualThesis: Der zuerst sichtbare hohe Preis 199 Euro lässt denselben späteren Preis von 129 Euro deutlich günstiger wirken.

scenes.speechSection: Warum wirkt ein Preis plötzlich günstig, nur weil du vorher eine höhere Zahl gesehen hast? Das nennt man Ankereffekt.
scenes.visualIdea: the same headphones feel cheaper after a high first price establishes an anchor
scenes.visualTask: Show the same headphones with 199 Euro as the dominant first reference and 129 Euro as the later price that suddenly feels cheaper. The mechanism must read before the title is read.
scenes.characterDirection: One STYLIZED_STICKMAN_CAST_V2 shopper only; simple dark teal jacket; surprised but believable bargain reaction, not exaggerated cartoon acting.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The shopper visually compares the same headphones across the 199-to-129 price shift.
scenes.environment: Believable modern electronics-store display with controlled detail and clear product hierarchy.
scenes.camera: Strong thumbnail-ready medium-wide retail composition with the headphones large and unmistakably central.
scenes.lightingMood: Controlled MONEY-mode retail light: warm product light against cooler store depth, intensity 2.
scenes.colorDirection: Graphite/cool blue store depth, restrained warm product accent, dark teal clothing; strong title contrast.
scenes.continuityPolicy: Scene 01 establishes local shopper identity for scenes 03-04 only; it is not the global style master.
scenes.titlePlacement: compact asymmetric integrated title block in reserved negative space, never a full-width top banner

scenes.speechSection: Die erste Zahl setzt einen mentalen Ausgangspunkt, an dem sich spätere Einschätzungen unbewusst orientieren.
scenes.visualIdea: first number becomes a reference point that shifts later judgment
scenes.visualTask: Illustrate a first numeric value becoming an anchor and pulling a later estimate toward it; no human required.
scenes.actionOrRelation: One first-value marker visibly becomes the reference point and pulls the later estimate toward it.
scenes.environment: Illustrated abstract mechanism space using the same channel linework, depth and cel-shading language.
scenes.lightingMood: Soft clear blue-amber dimensional light, intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Muted blue/teal base with restrained amber focal anchor; no corporate infographic palette.

scenes.speechSection: Stell dir vor, du siehst Kopfhörer zuerst für 199 Euro.
scenes.visualIdea: shopper first encounters headphones with a high initial price
scenes.visualTask: Show the Scene-01 shopper in an electronics store encountering the same headphones at the first price.
scenes.characterDirection: Same shopper as Scene 01, same head proportions and dark teal jacket; neutral evaluating posture.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Shopper looks directly at the headphones and the first price marker.
scenes.environment: Same believable electronics-store world, different camera position; product display is the focal context.
scenes.lightingMood: Clean warm product light with cooler aisle depth, MONEY intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Cool store depth, warm product focal zone, dark teal shopper.

scenes.speechSection: Kurz danach steht dort 129 Euro – und plötzlich fühlt sich das wie ein starkes Angebot an.
scenes.visualIdea: the same shopper now perceives 129 Euro as unusually attractive
scenes.visualTask: Show the same shopper and same headphones; the lower price now feels unusually attractive because of the earlier anchor.
scenes.characterDirection: Same Scene-01/03 shopper, same clothing and proportions; positive but natural reaction.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Shopper leans slightly toward the same product, visibly more attracted to the offer.
scenes.environment: Same electronics-store world with softer background and stronger product focus.
scenes.lightingMood: Warmer focal product light with cooler soft background, MONEY intensity 2.
scenes.colorDirection: Warm focal accent around product, controlled cool surroundings.

scenes.speechSection: Jemand, der nur 129 Euro sieht, kann denselben Preis deutlich neutraler beurteilen.
scenes.visualIdea: same final price feels different depending on whether a high anchor was seen first
scenes.visualTask: Compare two STYLIZED_STICKMAN_CAST_V2 shoppers evaluating identical headphones at the same final price; one saw the high anchor earlier, the other did not.
scenes.characterDirection: Two different individuals from the same anatomy family; one visibly more impressed, one neutral.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Side-by-side contrast of emotional evaluation while product and final-price context remain equivalent.
scenes.environment: Coherent electronics-store comparison, not two unrelated scenes.
scenes.lightingMood: Same store world with subtle warm/cool separation, MONEY intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Shared neutral store palette with slightly warmer emphasis on the anchored reaction side.
scenes.continuityPolicy: No identity continuity beyond same character family.

scenes.speechSection: Der erste Wert wirkt wie ein Anker, der deine spätere Schätzung in seine Richtung zieht.
scenes.visualIdea: a literal anchor pulls a value marker toward the first number
scenes.visualTask: Use a symbolic illustrated metal anchor attached to a value marker, visibly pulling the later estimate toward the first reference point.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The anchor creates a visible directional pull on the later estimate.
scenes.environment: Conceptual illustrated space with real dimensional depth, not a flat corporate diagram.
scenes.lightingMood: Focused warm anchor light against calm cool depth, CLEAR intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Deep blue/teal depth, restrained warm metal focal accent.

scenes.speechSection: Das passiert nicht nur beim Einkaufen.
scenes.visualTask: Show one central anchor motif with three small supporting visual cues for salary negotiation, apartment and car without readable labels.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The single anchor visually connects to the three non-retail contexts.
scenes.environment: Clean illustrated conceptual overview in the same 2D world.
scenes.camera: Clean illustrated overview with one dominant anchor and only three supporting cues.
scenes.lightingMood: Soft neutral cinematic light, CLEAR intensity 0.
scenes.colorDirection: Balanced muted channel colors; no loud icon palette.

scenes.speechSection: Auch bei Gehaltsverhandlungen, Wohnungen oder Autos kann die erste genannte Zahl den weiteren Vergleich verschieben.
scenes.visualIdea: first stated number influences a negotiation reference range
scenes.visualTask: Show two same-family stickman characters in a salary negotiation where one first offer visibly frames the discussion.
scenes.characterDirection: Two STYLIZED_STICKMAN_CAST_V2 adults with distinct simplified work clothing; one composed proposer, one attentive evaluator.
scenes.actionOrRelation: One person presents the first offer while the other visibly evaluates from that starting point.
scenes.environment: Believable professional negotiation room, not a sterile generic office.
scenes.camera: Medium two-person desk shot with both poses and the offer relationship readable.
scenes.lightingMood: Controlled professional warm/cool light, MONEY intensity 2.
scenes.colorDirection: Graphite/navy environment with restrained warm highlights and natural clothing colors.
scenes.continuityPolicy: New characters; no continuity with retail shopper.

scenes.speechSection: Ein frühes Angebot kann dadurch beeinflussen, welche späteren Zahlen überhaupt noch realistisch wirken.
scenes.visualIdea: first offer shifts the range that later options feel plausible within
scenes.visualTask: Show a first-offer marker setting a visible range, with later option markers clustering around the shifted reference zone; no human required.
scenes.actionOrRelation: First offer establishes a shifted range; later options gather around it.
scenes.environment: Dimensional illustrated mechanism space with no PowerPoint styling.
scenes.colorDirection: Muted graphite/teal base with restrained warm-gold focal marker.

scenes.speechSection: Sogar zufällige Zahlen können Schätzungen verschieben, besonders wenn dir ein klarer Vergleich fehlt.
scenes.visualIdea: an arbitrary number card bends an uncertain estimate scale
scenes.visualTask: Show an arbitrary number card beside an uncertain estimation scale, with the scale subtly bending toward the number.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The uncertain scale bends slightly toward the arbitrary number instead of staying centered.
scenes.environment: Quiet conceptual illustrated space with enough depth to feel part of the channel world.
scenes.lightingMood: Quiet cool surrounding light with one warm focal number source, UNEASY intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Cool muted field with restrained warm focal card; no random neon.

scenes.speechSection: Das bedeutet nicht, dass du jeder ersten Zahl automatisch glaubst.
scenes.visualIdea: person remains skeptical while still exposed to a first number
scenes.visualTask: Show one stickman-family person examining an initial offer skeptically instead of blindly accepting it.
scenes.characterDirection: One STYLIZED_STICKMAN_CAST_V2 adult with folded/guarded posture and restrained skeptical expression.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Person pauses and evaluates the offer rather than reaching for it.
scenes.environment: Believable everyday decision setting with abstract unreadable offer details.
scenes.lightingMood: Neutral directional light with mild tension, UNEASY intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Muted natural colors with controlled cool shadow and one warm offer focal point.

scenes.speechSection: Aber selbst wenn du weißt, dass ein Anker existiert, kann er deine Einschätzung trotzdem beeinflussen.
scenes.visualIdea: awareness of the anchor does not necessarily remove its pull
scenes.visualTask: Compare a clearly recognized anchor with a judgment marker that still remains slightly pulled toward it.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The anchor is consciously separated, yet the judgment marker remains measurably closer to it than neutral.
scenes.environment: Coherent symbolic split space using the same film-world rendering.
scenes.colorDirection: Cool neutral comparison field with restrained warm anchor influence.

scenes.speechSection: Ein einfacher Schutz ist, vor dem ersten Angebot eine eigene grobe Einschätzung festzulegen.
scenes.visualIdea: person forms an independent estimate before seeing the offer
scenes.visualTask: Show one stickman-family person calmly writing a private estimate before opening or viewing an offer.
scenes.characterDirection: One STYLIZED_STICKMAN_CAST_V2 adult with calm focused posture, simple olive sweater.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Person writes their own estimate first while the external offer remains unopened/unseen.
scenes.environment: Quiet believable desk setting with abstract marks only on paper/screen.
scenes.camera: Medium desk shot with independent estimate as the action focus.
scenes.lightingMood: Quiet warm desk light with cool background, HOPE intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Warm restrained focal light, calm cool depth, natural olive clothing.
scenes.continuityPolicy: New character; local continuity not required later.

scenes.speechSection: Danach vergleichst du mehrere unabhängige Preise, Daten oder Angebote statt nur mit der ersten Zahl.
scenes.visualIdea: multiple independent reference points reduce dependence on one anchor
scenes.visualTask: Show several independent reference markers around one decision instead of one dominant first value; no human required.
scenes.actionOrRelation: Several independent markers balance the decision so no single first value dominates.
scenes.environment: Clean dimensional illustrated decision space, not a corporate slide.
scenes.lightingMood: Balanced open cinematic light, HOPE intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Balanced teal/blue field with several restrained distinct reference accents.

scenes.speechSection: So bekommt dein Kopf mehrere Bezugspunkte und hängt weniger an einem einzigen Wert.
scenes.visualIdea: one heavy anchor is replaced by several balanced reference points
scenes.visualTask: Show one heavy anchor losing visual dominance as several balanced reference points appear around the decision space.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The single anchor becomes lighter/less dominant while multiple references create balance.
scenes.environment: Symbolic dimensional world with clear depth and calm resolution.
scenes.lightingMood: Calm warm resolution with soft blue depth, HOPE intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Warm restrained focal relief with balanced cool background references.

scenes.speechSection: Wenn dir eine Zahl sofort extrem günstig oder teuer vorkommt, frag dich: Was war eigentlich mein Anker?
scenes.visualIdea: closing question prompts the viewer to identify the reference number shaping judgment
scenes.visualTask: Show a clean anchor and price-tag illustration with the anchor visually separating from the final judgment.
scenes.actionOrRelation: The anchor separates from the judgment to visually invite reflection.
scenes.environment: Calm illustrated closing space with deliberate negative space for the exact question.
scenes.lightingMood: Calm warm focal light with cool surrounding space, HOPE intensity 1.
scenes.colorDirection: Warm focal accent, calm navy/teal depth, high text readability.
